entries.text: Salesforce Developer with 2+ years delivering production systems for B2B clients — published AppExchange package, triple-certified (PDI, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant), currently pursuing M.Sc. Software Development at Hochschule Fulda.

entries.description:
• Built and published a production AppExchange managed package through Salesforce's full security review cycle, enforcing 85%+ Apex test coverage via automated test suites.

  • Designed Salesforce REST integrations with HomeAdvisor and QuickBooks, automating lead ingestion and financial synchronization workflows — reducing manual administrative overhead and improving data visibility across sales and finance teams.

  • Engineered a zero-code form builder (LWC + Apex) with configurable 3-level parent-child object relationships, reducing form setup from several hours to under 10 minutes for internal business users.

  • Reduced deployment turnaround by ~40% by owning the team's Jenkins-based CI/CD pipeline integrated with GitHub, enforcing automated Apex test validation and code review standards across all releases.

• Engaged directly with client stakeholders to scope, design, and deliver REST APIs enabling real-time data exchange between an airplane parts inventory system and external buyers; owned the full project lifecycle from requirements analysis to production deployment.

entries.name: AI-Powered Document Generation Pipeline
entries.techStack: Node.js, Express, n8n, Playwright, Gemini API, OpenAI API, Docker
entries.description:
• Built an end-to-end automation system that collects job listings from multiple sources in parallel, uses AI to match role requirements and personalize application documents, and generates print-ready PDFs — replacing a fully manual process.

  • Engineered the backend API, document rendering pipeline, and multi-stage workflow orchestration; system runs unattended and produces consistent, styled output per run.

entries.name: Cloud Infrastructure Stack
entries.techStack: Terraform, AWS (VPC, EC2, ALB, ASG, RDS, EFS, WAF)
entries.description:
• Architected a production-grade 3-tier AWS infrastructure using Terraform: load-balanced web tier, auto-scaling compute, RDS MySQL, EFS shared storage, and WAF protection across multiple availability zones.

  • Managed ~41 cloud resources with reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure definitions ensuring consistent environment provisioning.
